easyPrerequisites: You control at least five artifacts.
description:
Cast Chromatic Orrery by paying at most {2} due to Sami.
Activate Chromatic Orrery by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate Meticulous Excavation by paying {2}{W}, returning Chromatic Orrery from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
